from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class RevenueMetric(BaseModel):
    """A single revenue figure extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company from the financial report")
    revenue_line_label: str | None = Field(description="The label of the line item where the revenue was found (e.g., 'Consolidated Total Revenues')")
    revenue_value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the revenue as reported")
    revenue_unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the reported number (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions')")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The time period the financial report covers (e.g., 'Three months ended March 31, 2024')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    revenue_metrics: list[RevenueMetric]
